title: Akhilesh alleges massive fraud with Ram Temple money; trust says audit underway
summary: It is very sensitive news for devotees of Lord Ram across the world that crores of rupees from donations made to the Ram Temple have been found missing, says Samajwadi Party president Akhilesh Yadav

title: YouTuber Maridhas arrested for videos defaming TVK government
summary: Sources said a case was registered against him by the Chennai City Cyber Crime Police for posting videos allegedly defaming the TVK-led coalition government in Tamil Nadu

title: Telangana CM to lay foundation stone for alternate road around AOC Centre, MMC office in Uppal Bhagayath
INDIA bloc meeting begins in New Delhi
summary: Amid disarray, Congress sought to project unity and said that even those skipping it had conveyed their “strong opposition” to the Narendra Modi government’s policies

title: Experts question Kerala’s move to assess carrying capacity of forests and conduct wildlife census to mitigate conflicts
summary: Environmentalists and wildlife experts argue that it risks reducing a complex ecological issue to wildlife numbers while overlooking habitat degradation, forest fragmentation and human pressures on forest ecosystems

title: Woman killed, son injured in wild elephant attack in Kerala’s Idukki
summary: Forest dept officials said the woman was walking her son to school when they encountered two wild elephants standing on the road. Due to heavy rain and thick mist, she failed to notice the animals

title: One killed, three injured as BEST bus crashes into multiple vehicles in Mumbai
summary: According to preliminary information, the bus driver allegedly lost control of the vehicle and as a result, the bus hit two cars, a cab and two motorbikes

title: Pay ₹10 lakh each to three child victims of sexual offence, orders Madras High Court
summary: Justice A.D. Jagadish Chandira directs Tamil Nadu government to pay the amount from the Child Victim Compensation Fund
